title: Chapter 51 — Trade Outreach: The Builder Cold Call
intro: The research-first standard and the opening that earns thirty seconds.

sections.title: Research Before You Call
sections.content:
Never cold call a builder or contractor without knowing something about their business. What projects are they working on? What is their specialty? What price point do they serve?

The opening that earns thirty seconds: 'I noticed your firm does mid-range kitchen renovations in [area]. We work with several contractors in the same market and I thought it might be worth a conversation about whether we could support your appliance sourcing.'

That is specific, respectful, and relevant. 'Hi, I am calling from an appliance store' is not.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating cold outreach, ask:

Does the salesperson research before calling — or dial blindly?
Is the opening specific and relevant — or generic?
Are they tracking outreach activity and results?
